stages.title: 风格
stages.text:
A clean, horizontal, three-step method flowchart on a pure white background, strictly left-to-right reading order.

**Layout & Structure:**
Three evenly spaced, rounded-rectangle process boxes aligned horizontally and connected by two distinct, dark-grey, orthogonal rightward-pointing arrows with standard arrowheads. The arrows are placed centrally between the boxes. No additional elements, values, or annotations are present.

**Style (NeurIPS-adherent “Soft Tech” refinement):**
- **Background:** Pure white artboard, ensuring a crisp, high-contrast academic presentation.
- **Box Shapes:** Softened-geometry rounded rectangles with a subtle border (`#B0B0B0`). Corner radius ~8 px for a modern, refined look.
- **Typography:** 
    - Chinese text labels: Clean, dark (`#333333`) **Sans-Serif** font (e.g., Arial/Noto Sans CJK), Bold weight.
    - Mathematical expressions (`n=12`, `x / x₀`, `均值 1.7`): **Serif** font (Times New Roman/LaTeX-style), Italicized where applicable, to strictly separate module names from variable data.

**Color Palette (Borrowing reference aesthetic with NeurIPS soft-pastel enhancement):**
- **First Box (Left):** Soft Tech Pastel Blue fill (`#E6F3FF`). Label: “样品输入” and “(n=12)”.
- **Second Box (Middle):** Bridging neutral Soft Cream/Yellow fill (`#FFF2CC`). Label: “数据标准化” and “(x / x₀)”. The fraction is clearly legible.
- **Third Box (Right):** Soft Pastel Green fill (`#E0F2E9`). Label: “结果输出” and “(均值 1.7)”.

**Identifier:**
The text identifier “REF-73” is placed in the absolute top-right corner of the figure, in a small, discreet, light-grey Sans-Serif font, exactly replicating the reference style.
